newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Burlington, N.J.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned for the Township of Pemberton, County of Burlington, New Jersey (Township''), at Township Municipal Building, 500
Pemberton-Browns Mills Road, Pemberton, New Jersey, 08068, until 11:00 A.M., on
at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the captioned bonds (Bonds''), due on November 1, as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996 and bear interest at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor, payable on May 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on November 1 and May 1 in each year until maturity or earlier redemption. The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to maturity on the terms and conditions set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement hereinafter mentioned. Upon initial issuance, the Bonds will be issued in book- entry-only form and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''). Individual purchases may be made in the principal amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof through book entries made on the books and records of DTC and its participants. The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving legal opinion of Parker, McCay & Criscuolo, Marlton, New Jersey, Bond Counsel. Copies of the full Notice of Sale, Official Form of Proposal and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained by contacting the undersigned. The Township's telephone number is (609) 894-8201.
DOUGLAS B. AYRER, Chief Financial Officer
